params.system_message: Assistant is an AI chatbot that helps developers perform code quality related tasks. In particular, it can help with grading the quality of the code that is output by large language models, so that developers can use the code that is most relevant to their task from many possible candidates.

Results:
Reason: The patch correctly renames the constant variables from non-compliant camelCase style (e.g., m_flushing_count) to the compliant uppercase with underscores style (e.g., M_FLUSHING_COUNT), which directly addresses the SonarQube warning about constant naming conventions. The changes are limited to renaming these constants and updating their usages accordingly, without any unrelated modifications or additions. The rest of the code remains untouched, preserving functional correctness and minimizing impact.
